title: Ibrance (palbociclib): Dosing, Monitoring, and Dose-Modification Instructions
instruction: For each clinical scenario, build the exact labelled instruction by selecting the correct phrase for every blank.

items.prompt: Initiating IBRANCE with an aromatase inhibitor or fulvestrant
items.rationale: The FDA-approved starting dose is 125 mg once daily for 21 consecutive days followed by 7 days off treatment, comprising a complete 28-day cycle; this schedule is unchanged regardless of which endocrine partner is used.
